content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi Isilaehi’walaŋ memikhiye u yehitubu-liwe titiŋdok ninadiguk
Bepaŋ, du mage teheŋa kabup mu haleŋ. Tiŋa kulemaŋgoŋ hogok hafit adi mu tibeŋ. Bepaŋ, du kabup gitagoŋ adi mu haleŋ!
Memikgeye mik tubupilakiiŋ gu yabeŋ. Me du gabukahile mu tiiŋ heki adi foko tigamiiŋ.
Adi kabup hebihali metamgeye yehitubu-kadakadok mede yofolok ha-tiiŋ. Du metamgeye yabukahileeŋ momooŋ yabudokolaŋ iŋgoŋ memik heki adi kabup bopneeŋ yehitubu-kadakadok yofafaŋe tiiŋ.
Tiŋa indiŋ yoiŋ, “Unim ale, indi wooŋ Isilaehi yehitubu-liwedapmahinaka tinim, kaŋ metamdi Isilaehi kotigoŋ mu nadiyemiŋa kauleyem tineeŋ.”
Adi mik tigamdok welekubugoŋ tiŋa tiiŋ. Tiŋa adi wanakaŋ bopneeŋ indi nihibefofoŋdok tiiŋ.
Mebop indiŋdi kwanai u tine tiiŋ, Idomhi, Ismaelhi eŋ Moaphi, Hakilihi eŋ Gebalhi, Amonhi eŋ Amelekhi, Filistiahi tiŋa Taiyahi. Adi wanakaŋ bopneeŋ mik tinimiiŋ.
Eŋ Asiliyahidi maaŋ adigut wooŋ kiukiiŋ. Mebop fafaŋehi woŋ adi Lot’walaŋ yalakiŋiye
Du koom Kison ime wapumneŋ uŋoŋ Midianhi mik tiyemiŋa talitimeŋhiyat Sisela gut Yabin, aditok kudi tiyemguŋ, undugoŋ hinek aditokbo tiyembeŋ.
Nai uŋaniŋ Endol yokwet wapumneŋ uŋoŋ yehitubu-kadakaguŋ kaŋ foloohik kwetfoloŋ gwaŋ hali wooŋ bitakagiŋ.
Du koom Olep tiŋa Siyep uŋoŋ tiyemguŋ wendok tuwolit hinek memikhiye diniŋ talitimeŋhiyedok tiyembeŋ. Eŋ Seba tiŋa Salmuna uŋoŋ tuguŋ undugoŋ hinek me talitimeŋhiye u yehimoŋgofofoŋ tibeŋ.
Me heki u indiŋ yogiŋ, “Indi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwet metamŋiyedok yemguk u kahilene indetok kwetnik tibek.”
Bepaŋne, du me heki u kwam nabugoŋ beŋa yakulune udapmaneŋ. Be sububadi bem hapmuŋ kumuhi feedi beŋa kutak nabugoŋ beŋa yakulune uneŋ.
Kudupdi ipaŋ dalak, kaŋ kweboboe ipaŋnit adi gibitaŋ dawetik.
Wondok tuwot hinek du nadiweŋ kaŋ gwi wapum maaŋ mebop u yehikeleune momoŋ uneŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ, nadiweŋ kaŋ fifiŋgobutdi adi’walaŋkade fedila uune munta tineŋ.
Yahwe, du yehimoŋgofohinaka tibeŋ, kaŋ adi mekahinakaaŋ wabiŋa du gehikeledok nadineeŋ.
Yehibefooŋ widihidapmaune adi helemahelemaŋ munta hogok taneeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa yehitubu-mekaune mekanit hatigene kumuŋ tineeŋ.
Du unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ adi indiŋ u kedem naditomneŋ, du kubugoŋ hogokdi Yahwe eŋ Bepaŋ Loloŋnit hinek, tiŋa da kubugoŋdi kwetkwet hogohogok u kadokolaŋ.

footnotes.text: Lot’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi Moaphi gut Amonhi. Kwet welewele gineŋ kaweŋ.
